rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.privateTensor_eq
rows.statement:
theorem privateTensor_eq {p : ℕ+} {n1 n2 : ℕ} (z1 : Fin n1 → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    privateTensor z1 z2 = fun i => Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun a b => a * b)
      (fun (_ : Fin 1) j => z1 j) (fun (_ : Fin 1) j => z2 j)

rows.statement:
theorem quadEval_eq {p : ℕ+} {l n1 n2 d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l (n1 * n2) d)

    (z2 : Fin n2 → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :

rows.statement:
theorem phfeEval_eq {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l (n * n) d)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    phfeEval C x y = quadEval C x y y

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.phfeEval_sum
rows.statement:
theorem phfeEval_sum {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ} (C : PolyTensor p l (n * n) d)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    phfeEval C x y = ∑ j : Fin n, ∑ k : Fin n,
      polyTensorEval C x (finProdFinEquiv (j, k)) * y j * y k

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.phfeClass_eval
rows.statement:
theorem phfeClass_eval (l n w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (f : Fin ((tensorFnLen l (.mul n n) w d).eval kappa) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (y : Fin (n.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).eval kappa p f x y =
      phfeEval (decodeTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n.eval kappa * n.eval kappa) d (w.eval kappa) f)
        (decodeResidues p (l.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) x)
        (decodeResidues p (n.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) y)

    (hwidth : (p : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ w.eval kappa)
    (C : PolyTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n.eval kappa * n.eval kappa) d)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (y : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (xword : Fin (l.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (yword : Fin (n.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (hx : List.ofFn xword = Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (w.eval kappa) x)
    (hy : List.ofFn yword = Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (w.eval kappa) y) :
    (phfeClass l n w d).eval kappa p (encodeTensorBits (w.eval kappa) C) xword yword =
      phfeEval C x y

rows.statement:
theorem quadClass_eval (l n1 n2 w : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+)
    (f : Fin ((tensorFnLen l (.mul n1 n2) w d).eval kappa) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa * w.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (z : Fin ((n1.eval kappa + n2.eval kappa) * w.eval kappa) → Bool) :
    (quadClass l n1 n2 w d).eval kappa p f x z =
      quadEval (decodeTensor p (l.eval kappa) (n1.eval kappa * n2.eval kappa) d (w.eval kappa) f)
        (decodeResidues p (l.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) x)
        (fun i => decodeResidues p (n1.eval kappa + n2.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) z
          (Fin.castAdd (n2.eval kappa) i))
        (fun j => decodeResidues p (n1.eval kappa + n2.eval kappa) (w.eval kappa) z
          (Fin.natAdd (n1.eval kappa) j))

    (P : MvPolynomial (Fin l ⊕ Fin n) (ZMod (p : ℕ))) :
    BidegreeAtMost d e P ↔
      ∀ s : (Fin l ⊕ Fin n) →₀ ℕ, MvPolynomial.coeff s P ≠ 0 →
        (∑ i : Fin l, s (Sum.inl i)) ≤ d ∧ (∑ j : Fin n, s (Sum.inr j)) ≤ e

theorem pad_one {p : ℕ+} {l n d : ℕ}

    (hdeg : BidegreeAtMost d 2 P) :
    ∃ C : PolyTensor p l ((n + 1) * (n + 1)) d,
      ∀ (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (y : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)),
        MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim x y) P = phfeEval C x (Fin.snoc y 1)

  /-- The public parameters drawn before setup. -/
  pp : PublicParams S.G κ
  /-- The master public key from setup. -/
  pk : S.MPK κ pp
  /-- The function key generated from the corresponding master secret key. -/
  sk : S.SK κ pp
  /-- The encryption of the public and private inputs. -/
  ct : S.CT κ pp

/-- An honest experiment generates parameters and keys, encrypts the inputs, then produces
the function key [GJLS21, Definition 4.2]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.honestRun
rows.statement:
noncomputable def honestRun (κ : ℕ) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    ProbComp (S.HonestOutcome κ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.honestRun_eq
rows.statement:
theorem honestRun_eq (κ : ℕ) (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) :
    S.honestRun κ f x y =
      (S.pubGen κ).bind fun pp =>
      (S.setup κ pp).bind fun k =>
      (S.enc κ pp k.1 x y).bind fun ct =>
      (fun sk => ⟨pp, k.1, sk, ct⟩) <$> S.keyGen κ pp k.2 f

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.correct_iff
rows.statement:
theorem correct_iff : S.Correct ↔
    ∀ κ f x y, (S.honestRun κ f x y).AllOutputs fun o =>
      S.dec κ o.pp o.sk x o.ct =
        some (S.embed κ o.pp (C.eval κ (S.cprm κ o.pp) f x y))

rows.statement:

    ∀ κ f x y, ProbComp.prob (S.honestRun κ f x y) (fun o =>
      S.dec κ o.pp o.sk x o.ct ≠
        some (S.embed κ o.pp (C.eval κ (S.cprm κ o.pp) f x y))) ≤ ε κ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme
rows.statement:
structure FEScheme (C : FnClass) extends FEScheme.Raw C where
  /-- Uniformly sample and attach the public generator after the group description. -/
  pubGen_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (d : GroupDescription G κ) => d.val)
    (fun κ d (g : GeneratorDraw G κ d) => List.ofFn ((G.group κ d.val).encG g.val))
    (fun κ _ (pp : PublicParams G κ) => pp.encode) (publicParamsCore G)
  /-- Uniformly sample the complete setup draw and compute the encoded key pair. -/
  setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (pp : PublicParams G κ) => pp.encode) encSetupDraw
    (fun κ pp (k : MPK κ pp × MSK κ pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (encMPK κ pp k.1)) (List.ofFn (encMSK κ pp k.2))) setupCore
  /-- Uniformly sample encryption randomness with all other inputs on the parameter word. -/
  enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams G κ,
        MPK κ pp × (Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) × (Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
      pairEncode π.1.encode (pairEncode (List.ofFn (encMPK κ π.1 π.2.1))
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn π.2.2.1) (List.ofFn π.2.2.2))))
    (fun κ π => encEncDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)
    (fun κ π (c : CT κ π.1) => List.ofFn (encCT κ π.1 c))
    (fun κ π => encCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)
  /-- Uniformly sample key randomness with the master key and function on the input. -/
  keyGen_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams G κ, MSK κ pp × (Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
      pairEncode π.1.encode
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn (encMSK κ π.1 π.2.1)) (List.ofFn π.2.2)))
    (fun κ π => encKeyDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)
    (fun κ π (k : SK κ π.1) => List.ofFn (encSK κ π.1 k))
    (fun κ π => keyCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)
  /-- One polynomial-time decryption function works for every security and public parameter. -/
  dec_eff : ∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
    ∀ κ (pp : PublicParams G κ) (sk : SK κ pp)
      (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (ct : CT κ pp),
      a (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode pp.encode
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn (encSK κ pp sk))
          (pairEncode (List.ofFn x) (List.ofFn (encCT κ pp ct)))))) =
        match dec κ pp sk x ct with
        | none => [false]
        | some o => true :: List.ofFn (encDecOut κ pp o)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FnClass
rows.statement:
structure FnClass where
  /-- The width of the public input. -/
  pubLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of the private input. -/
  privLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of a function description. -/
  fnLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The class parameter at each security parameter. -/
  Prm : ℕ → Type
  /-- The evaluation codomain before the scheme's output embedding. -/
  Out : (κ : ℕ) → Prm κ → Type
  /-- A canonical wire encoding for a function value supplied to a simulator. -/
  encValue : (κ : ℕ) → (π : Prm κ) → Out κ π → List Bool
  /-- The value encoding preserves the simulator's allowed value. -/
  encValue_injective : ∀ κ π, Function.Injective (encValue κ π)
  /-- Evaluation of a function on the public and private inputs. -/
  eval : (κ : ℕ) → (π : Prm κ) → (Fin (fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) →
    (Fin (pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (Fin (privLen.eval κ) → Bool) → Out κ π

/-- The raw syntax of public-key functional encryption consists of deterministic cores and
finite exact draws, with deterministic decryption [GJLS21, Definition 4.1].

All key and ciphertext types depend on the public parameters so group-valued objects retain
their drawn group. Inputs and function descriptions use the function class's fixed-width
wire types. The output embedding is injective and fixed by the public parameters; it may map
scalar function values into the target group. Efficiency is added by `FEScheme`. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw
rows.statement:
structure FEScheme.Raw (C : FnClass) where
  /-- The uniform group-description generator. -/
  G : BilinearGen
  /-- The class parameter fixed by public parameters. -/
  cprm : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → C.Prm κ
  /-- The width of an encoded master public key. -/
  mpkLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of an encoded master secret key. -/
  mskLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of an encoded function key. -/
  skLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of the ciphertext excluding its separately public input. -/
  ctLen : PolyExpr
  /-- The width of a successful decryption output. -/
  decOutLen : PolyExpr
  /-- Master public keys over the drawn group. -/
  MPK : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Master secret keys over the drawn group. -/
  MSK : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Functional decryption keys over the drawn group. -/
  SK : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Ciphertexts over the drawn group. -/
  CT : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- The decryption codomain, before the optional failure marker. -/
  DecOut : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Interpret a function value in the decryption codomain. -/
  embed : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → C.Out κ (cprm κ pp) → DecOut κ pp
  /-- The embedding loses no information about the function value. -/
  embed_injective : ∀ κ pp, Function.Injective (embed κ pp)
  /-- The single draw type of setup. -/
  SetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams G κ → Type
  /-- Setup draws have a finite uniform law. -/
  [setupDrawFintype : ∀ κ pp, Fintype (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- Setup draws are nonempty. -/
  [setupDrawNonempty : ∀ κ pp, Nonempty (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- The deterministic setup core. -/
  setupCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → MPK κ pp × MSK κ pp
  /-- The single draw type of encryption. -/
  EncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MPK κ pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) → Type
  /-- Encryption draws have a finite uniform law. -/
  [encDrawFintype : ∀ κ pp pk x y, Fintype (EncDraw κ pp pk x y)]
  /-- Encryption draws are nonempty. -/
  [encDrawNonempty : ∀ κ pp pk x y, Nonempty (EncDraw κ pp pk x y)]
  /-- The deterministic encryption core, with both public and private inputs. -/
  encCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (pk : MPK κ pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) →
    EncDraw κ pp pk x y → CT κ pp
  /-- The single draw type of key generation. -/
  KeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MSK κ pp →
    (Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) → Type
  /-- Key-generation draws have a finite uniform law. -/
  [keyDrawFintype : ∀ κ pp msk f, Fintype (KeyDraw κ pp msk f)]
  /-- Key-generation draws are nonempty. -/
  [keyDrawNonempty : ∀ κ pp msk f, Nonempty (KeyDraw κ pp msk f)]
  /-- The deterministic key-generation core. -/
  keyCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (msk : MSK κ pp) →
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) → KeyDraw κ pp msk f → SK κ pp
  /-- Deterministic decryption, including the public input and an optional failure result. -/
  dec : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SK κ pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → CT κ pp → Option (DecOut κ pp)
  /-- The master public key's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encMPK : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MPK κ pp → Fin (mpkLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The master secret key's fixed-width encoding, used by efficiency specifications. -/
  encMSK : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → MSK κ pp → Fin (mskLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The functional key's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encSK : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SK κ pp → Fin (skLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The ciphertext's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encCT : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → CT κ pp → Fin (ctLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The successful output's fixed-width encoding. -/
  encDecOut : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → DecOut κ pp →
    Fin (decOutLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The encoding of the complete setup draw. -/
  encSetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → List Bool
  /-- The encoding of the complete encryption draw. -/
  encEncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (pk : MPK κ pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) → (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool) →
    EncDraw κ pp pk x y → List Bool
  /-- The encoding of the complete key-generation draw. -/
  encKeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams G κ) → (msk : MSK κ pp) →
    (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool) → KeyDraw κ pp msk f → List Bool
  /-- Public-key encodings distinguish every possible setup output at fixed parameters. -/
  encMPK_inj : ∀ κ pp (r r' : SetupDraw κ pp),
    encMPK κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 = encMPK κ pp (setupCore κ pp r').1 →
      (setupCore κ pp r).1 = (setupCore κ pp r').1
  /-- Function-key encodings distinguish possible keys under one master secret key. -/
  encSK_inj : ∀ κ pp (r : SetupDraw κ pp) f f'
    (t : KeyDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f)
    (t' : KeyDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f'),
    encSK κ pp (keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f t) =
      encSK κ pp (keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f' t') →
    keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f t = keyCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).2 f' t'
  /-- Ciphertext encodings distinguish possible ciphertexts under one public key. -/
  encCT_inj : ∀ κ pp (r : SetupDraw κ pp) x y x' y'
    (t : EncDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x y)
    (t' : EncDraw κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x' y'),
    encCT κ pp (encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x y t) =
      encCT κ pp (encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x' y' t') →
    encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x y t = encCore κ pp (setupCore κ pp r).1 x' y' t'
  /-- Successful decryption values have lossless encodings. -/
  encDecOut_injective : ∀ κ pp, Function.Injective (encDecOut κ pp)

  /-- The committed functions, in their original order. -/

  /-- Their allowed values on the challenge. -/

namespace Omega

variable {S}

/-- The simulator information is encoded by its count, public input, and ordered pairs.
This is encoding glue for the stateful simulator of [GJLS21, Definition 4.3]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.Omega.encode

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.Omega.encode_eq
rows.statement:
theorem encode_eq {κ : ℕ} {pp : PublicParams S.G κ} (ω : S.Omega κ pp) :
    ω.encode = pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size ω.count) ω.count)
      (pairEncode (List.ofFn ω.publicInput)
        ((List.ofFn fun j => pairEncode (List.ofFn (ω.functions j))
          (C.encValue κ (S.cprm κ pp) (ω.values j))).foldr pairEncode []))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.Simulator.Raw
rows.statement:
structure Simulator.Raw where
  /-- The simulator's private state. -/
  St : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G κ → Type
  /-- A canonical encoding of the private state. -/
  encSt : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → St κ pp → List Bool
  /-- Equal state words retain equal states. -/
  encSt_injective : ∀ κ pp, Function.Injective (encSt κ pp)
  /-- The complete setup draw. -/
  SetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G κ → Type
  /-- Setup draws are finite. -/
  [setupFinite : ∀ κ pp, Fintype (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- Setup draws are nonempty. -/
  [setupNonempty : ∀ κ pp, Nonempty (SetupDraw κ pp)]
  /-- Simulated setup returns a public key and private state. -/
  setupCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → S.MPK κ pp × St κ pp
  /-- The complete ciphertext-simulation draw, depending on its other inputs. -/
  EncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → St κ pp → S.Omega κ pp → Type
  /-- Ciphertext-simulation draws are finite. -/
  [encFinite : ∀ κ pp st ω, Fintype (EncDraw κ pp st ω)]
  /-- Ciphertext-simulation draws are nonempty. -/
  [encNonempty : ∀ κ pp st ω, Nonempty (EncDraw κ pp st ω)]
  /-- Ciphertext simulation returns the ciphertext and updated private state. -/
  encCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) → (ω : S.Omega κ pp) →
    EncDraw κ pp st ω → S.CT κ pp × St κ pp
  /-- The complete draw of one indexed key-simulation query. -/
  KeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → St κ pp →
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) → Fin ω.count → Type
  /-- Key-simulation draws are finite. -/
  [keyFinite : ∀ κ pp st ω j, Fintype (KeyDraw κ pp st ω j)]
  /-- Key-simulation draws are nonempty. -/
  [keyNonempty : ∀ κ pp st ω j, Nonempty (KeyDraw κ pp st ω j)]
  /-- Key simulation returns the functional key and updated private state. -/
  keyCore : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) →
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) → (j : Fin ω.count) → KeyDraw κ pp st ω j → S.SK κ pp × St κ pp
  /-- Encode a complete setup draw. -/
  encSetupDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → SetupDraw κ pp → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete ciphertext-simulation draw. -/
  encEncDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) → (ω : S.Omega κ pp) →
    EncDraw κ pp st ω → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete key-simulation draw. -/
  encKeyDraw : (κ : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) → (st : St κ pp) →
    (ω : S.Omega κ pp) → (j : Fin ω.count) → KeyDraw κ pp st ω j → List Bool

rows.statement:
structure Simulator extends Simulator.Raw S where
  /-- Setup sampling and its state/output encoding are uniformly efficient. -/
  setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) => pp.encode) encSetupDraw
    (fun κ pp (o : S.MPK κ pp × St κ pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encMPK κ pp o.1)) (encSt κ pp o.2)) setupCore
  /-- Ciphertext simulation is uniformly efficient with its state and information on input. -/
  enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.encInputWord
    (fun κ π => encEncDraw κ π.pp π.state π.omega)
    (fun κ π (o : S.CT κ π.pp × St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encCT κ π.pp o.1)) (encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => encCore κ π.pp π.state π.omega)
  /-- Indexed key simulation is uniformly efficient with all other inputs on its word. -/
  key_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.keyInputWord
    (fun κ π => encKeyDraw κ π.pp π.state π.omega π.index)
    (fun κ π (o : S.SK κ π.pp × St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encSK κ π.pp o.1)) (encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => keyCore κ π.pp π.state π.omega π.index)

rows.statement:
def pgbCore
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : (Fin n ⊕ M) → ZMod (p : ℕ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.pgbCore_eq
rows.statement:
theorem pgbCore_eq
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    pgbCore L1 L0 x z t = Sum.elim (fun j => z j - t (Sum.inr j))
      (Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.pgbCore_inl
rows.statement:
theorem pgbCore_inl
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (j : Fin n) :
    pgbCore L1 L0 x z t (Sum.inl j) = z j - t (Sum.inr j)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.pgbCore_inr
rows.statement:
theorem pgbCore_inr
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : M) :
    pgbCore L1 L0 x z t (Sum.inr u) =
      Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0) u

rows.statement:
def pgbStarCore
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ))) (m0 : M)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : (Fin n ⊕ M) → ZMod (p : ℕ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.pgbStarCore_eq
rows.statement:
theorem pgbStarCore_eq
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))
    (L0 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) M (ZMod (p : ℕ))) (m0 : M)
    (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (T ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    pgbStarCore L1 L0 m0 x mu t = Sum.elim (fun j => -t (Sum.inr j))
      (fun u => Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0) u +
        if u = m0 then mu else 0)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.pgbStarCore_inr
rows.statement:
theorem pgbStarCore_inr
    (L1 : Matrix (T ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × M) (ZMod (p : ℕ)))

      Matrix.vecMul t (L1 * publicTensor x + L0) u + if u = m0 then mu else 0

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw
rows.statement:
structure Raw (l n : PolyExpr) (Fn : (kappa : ℕ) → ℕ+ → Type) where
  /-- Non-output coordinates, including the distinguished source coordinate. -/
  MIdx : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → Type
  /-- Auxiliary draw coordinates; output coordinates form the final draw block. -/
  TIdx : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → Type
  /-- Each non-output coordinate type is finite. -/
  [mFinite : ∀ kappa p f, Fintype (MIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- Each auxiliary draw-coordinate type is finite. -/
  [tFinite : ∀ kappa p f, Fintype (TIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- Equality of non-output coordinates is decidable. -/
  [mDecEq : ∀ kappa p f, DecidableEq (MIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- Equality of auxiliary draw coordinates is decidable. -/
  [tDecEq : ∀ kappa p f, DecidableEq (TIdx kappa p f)]
  /-- The number of non-output coordinates. -/
  mCount : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → ℕ
  /-- A polynomial bound on the non-output dimension, fixed by the function class
  independently of the modulus and adaptively chosen function. This is the size
  bound in [AGW20, Lemma 2, p.12], not an algorithm-efficiency hypothesis. -/
  mBound : PolyExpr
  /-- Every represented function uses at most the fixed polynomial node bound. -/
  mCount_le_mBound : ∀ kappa p f, mCount kappa p f ≤ mBound.eval kappa
  /-- The number of auxiliary draw coordinates. -/
  auxCount : (kappa : ℕ) → (p : ℕ+) → Fn kappa p → ℕ
  /-- Explicit non-output coordinates in the order used on machine inputs. -/
  mCoord : ∀ kappa p f, MIdx kappa p f ≃ Fin (mCount kappa p f)
  /-- Explicit auxiliary coordinates in the order used on machine inputs. -/
  tCoord : ∀ kappa p f, TIdx kappa p f ≃ Fin (auxCount kappa p f)
  /-- There is one fewer auxiliary coordinate than non-output coordinates. -/
  auxCount_add_one : ∀ kappa p f, auxCount kappa p f + 1 = mCount kappa p f
  /-- The distinguished coordinate receiving the simulated allowed value. -/
  m0 : ∀ kappa p f, MIdx kappa p f
  /-- The distinguished coordinate is the first encoded non-output coordinate. -/
  m0_coord : ∀ kappa p f, (mCoord kappa p f (m0 kappa p f)).val = 0
  /-- The width of a function's binary description. -/
  fnLen : ℕ → ℕ+ → ℕ
  /-- The fixed-width encoding of a function. -/
  encFn : ∀ kappa p, Fn kappa p → Fin (fnLen kappa p) → Bool
  /-- Equal function descriptions represent equal functions of the family. -/
  encFn_inj : ∀ kappa p, Function.Injective (encFn kappa p)
  /-- Evaluation of the represented polynomial vector at the public input. -/
  eval : ∀ kappa p, Fn kappa p → (Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) →
    Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)
  /-- The public-variable coefficient matrix, with corrected shape t×(ℓm). -/
  L1 : ∀ kappa p f,
    Matrix (TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa))
      (Fin (l.eval kappa) × MIdx kappa p f) (ZMod (p : ℕ))
  /-- The constant coefficient matrix, with corrected shape t×m. -/
  L0 : ∀ kappa p f,
    Matrix (TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) (MIdx kappa p f) (ZMod (p : ℕ))
  /-- The reconstruction vector, with output coordinates followed by non-output ones. -/
  recVec : ∀ (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p), (Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) →
    (Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ)
  /-- Every draw reconstructs the allowed scalar by the displayed dot product. -/
  rec_spec : ∀ kappa p f x z t,
    dotProduct (pgbCore (L1 kappa p f) (L0 kappa p f) x z t) (recVec kappa p f x) =
      dotProduct z (eval kappa p f x)
  /-- Real and simulated garblings have exactly equal expectations for every test. -/
  privacy : ∀ kappa p f x z
    (test : ((Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) → ℝ),
    ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (pgbCore (L1 kappa p f) (L0 kappa p f) x z t)) =
      ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (pgbStarCore (L1 kappa p f) (L0 kappa p f) (m0 kappa p f)
          x (dotProduct z (eval kappa p f x)) t))

rows.statement:
def pgbStar (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.pgbStar_eq
rows.statement:
theorem pgbStar_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (mu : ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    S.pgbStar kappa p f x mu t =
      pgbStarCore (S.L1 kappa p f) (S.L0 kappa p f) (S.m0 kappa p f) x mu t

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.reconstruct
rows.statement:
theorem reconstruct (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (t : (S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    dotProduct (S.pgb kappa p f x z t) (S.recVec kappa p f x) =
      dotProduct z (S.eval kappa p f x)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.exactPrivacy
rows.statement:
theorem exactPrivacy (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin (n.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (test : ((Fin (n.eval kappa) ⊕ S.MIdx kappa p f) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) → ℝ) :
    ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (S.pgb kappa p f x z t)) =
      ProbComp.expect
        (ProbComp.sample ((S.TIdx kappa p f ⊕ Fin (n.eval kappa)) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (S.pgbStar kappa p f x (dotProduct z (S.eval kappa p f x)) t))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.rowCoord
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.rowCoord_eq
rows.statement:
theorem rowCoord_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    S.rowCoord kappa p f =
      (Equiv.sumCongr (S.tCoord kappa p f) (Equiv.refl _)).trans finSumFinEquiv

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.l1ColCoord
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.l1ColCoord_eq
rows.statement:
theorem l1ColCoord_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    S.l1ColCoord kappa p f =
      (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl _) (S.mCoord kappa p f)).trans finProdFinEquiv

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.outputCoord
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.outputCoord_eq
rows.statement:
theorem outputCoord_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    S.outputCoord kappa p f =
      (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl _) (S.mCoord kappa p f)).trans finSumFinEquiv

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encMIdx
rows.statement: def encMIdx (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) (u : S.MIdx kappa p f) : List Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encMIdx_eq
rows.statement:
theorem encMIdx_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) (u : S.MIdx kappa p f) :
    S.encMIdx kappa p f u =
      Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (S.mCount kappa p f)) (S.mCoord kappa p f u).val

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encTIdx
rows.statement: def encTIdx (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) (u : S.TIdx kappa p f) : List Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encTIdx_eq
rows.statement:
theorem encTIdx_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) (u : S.TIdx kappa p f) :
    S.encTIdx kappa p f u =
      Candidates.natToList (Nat.size (S.auxCount kappa p f)) (S.tCoord kappa p f u).val

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encLgen
rows.statement: def encLgen (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) : List Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encLgen_eq
rows.statement:
theorem encLgen_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    S.encLgen kappa p f = pairEncode
      (Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix (Nat.size (p : ℕ))
        (fun i j => S.L1 kappa p f ((S.rowCoord kappa p f).symm i)
          ((S.l1ColCoord kappa p f).symm j)))
      (Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix (Nat.size (p : ℕ))
        (fun i j => S.L0 kappa p f ((S.rowCoord kappa p f).symm i)
          ((S.mCoord kappa p f).symm j)))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encRec
rows.statement:
def encRec (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : List Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.encRec_eq
rows.statement:
theorem encRec_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    S.encRec kappa p f x = Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (Nat.size (p : ℕ))
      (fun i => S.recVec kappa p f x ((S.outputCoord kappa p f).symm i))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.lgenInput
rows.statement: def lgenInput (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) : List Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.lgenInput_eq
rows.statement:
theorem lgenInput_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) :
    S.lgenInput kappa p f = NUPPT.advInput kappa
      (pairEncode (paramWord l n kappa p) (List.ofFn (S.encFn kappa p f)))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.recInput
rows.statement:
def recInput (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : List Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Raw.recInput_eq
rows.statement:
theorem recInput_eq (kappa : ℕ) (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p)
    (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    S.recInput kappa p f x = NUPPT.advInput kappa (pairEncode (paramWord l n kappa p)
      (pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encFn kappa p f))
        (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (Nat.size (p : ℕ)) x)))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling
rows.statement:
structure PartialGarbling (l n : PolyExpr) (Fn : (kappa : ℕ) → ℕ+ → Type)
    extends PartialGarbling.Raw l n Fn where
  /-- One deterministic polynomial-time map generates both encoded matrices for
  all security parameters, positive moduli and encoded functions. -/
  lgen_eff : ∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
    ∀ kappa (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p),
      a (toRaw.lgenInput kappa p f) = toRaw.encLgen kappa p f
  /-- One deterministic polynomial-time map reconstructs the encoded vector for
  all security parameters, positive moduli, functions and public inputs. -/
  rec_eff : ∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
    ∀ kappa (p : ℕ+) (f : Fn kappa p) (x : Fin (l.eval kappa) → ZMod (p : ℕ)),
      a (toRaw.recInput kappa p f x) = toRaw.encRec kappa p f x

namespace PartialGarbling

variable {l n : PolyExpr} {Fn : (kappa : ℕ) → ℕ+ → Type} (S : PartialGarbling l n Fn)

/-- The efficient interface's raw family has the same non-output index types. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.toRaw_MIdx
rows.statement: theorem toRaw_MIdx : S.toRaw.MIdx = S.MIdx

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.toRaw_TIdx
rows.statement: theorem toRaw_TIdx : S.toRaw.TIdx = S.TIdx

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.toRaw_L1
rows.statement: theorem toRaw_L1 : S.toRaw.L1 = S.L1

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.toRaw_L0
rows.statement: theorem toRaw_L0 : S.toRaw.L0 = S.L0

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.toRaw_rec
rows.statement: theorem toRaw_rec : S.toRaw.recVec = S.recVec

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.toRaw_eval
rows.statement: theorem toRaw_eval : S.toRaw.eval = S.eval

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.MIdx
rows.statement: abbrev MIdx (l d : ℕ) : Type

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.mIdx_eq
rows.statement:
theorem mIdx_eq (l d : ℕ) :
    MIdx l d = (Σ k : Fin (d + 1), Fin k.val → Fin (l + 1))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.TIdx
rows.statement: abbrev TIdx (l d : ℕ) : Type

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.tIdx_eq
rows.statement:
theorem tIdx_eq (l d : ℕ) :
    TIdx l d = (Σ k : Fin d, Fin (k.val + 1) → Fin (l + 1))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.root
rows.statement: def root (l d : ℕ) : MIdx l d

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.root_eq
rows.statement: theorem root_eq (l d : ℕ) : root l d = ⟨⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ d⟩, Fin.elim0⟩

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.node
rows.statement: def node {l d : ℕ} (v : TIdx l d) : MIdx l d

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.node_eq
rows.statement: theorem node_eq {l d : ℕ} (v : TIdx l d) : node v = ⟨v.1.succ, v.2⟩

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.parent
rows.statement: def parent {l d : ℕ} (v : TIdx l d) : MIdx l d

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.parent_eq
rows.statement:
theorem parent_eq {l d : ℕ} (v : TIdx l d) :
    parent v = ⟨v.1.castSucc, Fin.init v.2⟩

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.lastLabel
rows.statement: def lastLabel {l d : ℕ} (v : TIdx l d) : Fin (l + 1)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.lastLabel_eq
rows.statement:
theorem lastLabel_eq {l d : ℕ} (v : TIdx l d) :
    lastLabel v = v.2 (Fin.last v.1.val)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.leaf
rows.statement: def leaf {l d : ℕ} (tau : Fin d → Fin (l + 1)) : MIdx l d

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.leaf_eq
rows.statement:
theorem leaf_eq {l d : ℕ} (tau : Fin d → Fin (l + 1)) :
    leaf tau = ⟨Fin.last d, tau⟩

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeCount
rows.statement: def nodeCount (l d : ℕ) : ℕ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeCount_eq
rows.statement: theorem nodeCount_eq (l d : ℕ) : nodeCount l d = ∑ k : Fin (d + 1), (l + 1) ^ k.val

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.auxCount
rows.statement: def auxCount (l d : ℕ) : ℕ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.auxCount_eq
rows.statement: theorem auxCount_eq (l d : ℕ) : auxCount l d = ∑ k : Fin d, (l + 1) ^ (k.val + 1)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeBound
rows.statement:
def nodeBound (l : PolyExpr) : ℕ → PolyExpr
  | 0 => .const 1
  | d + 1 => .add (nodeBound l d) (.pow (.add l (PolyExpr.const 1)) (d + 1))

/-- At degree zero the node bound is the constant polynomial 1. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeBound_zero
rows.statement: theorem nodeBound_zero (l : PolyExpr) : nodeBound l 0 = .const 1

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeBound_succ
rows.statement:
theorem nodeBound_succ (l : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) :
    nodeBound l (d + 1) = .add (nodeBound l d) (.pow (.add l (PolyExpr.const 1)) (d + 1))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeBound_eval
rows.statement:
theorem nodeBound_eval (l : PolyExpr) (d kappa : ℕ) :
    (nodeBound l d).eval kappa = nodeCount (l.eval kappa) d

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.auxCount_add_one
rows.statement: theorem auxCount_add_one (l d : ℕ) : auxCount l d + 1 = nodeCount l d

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeCoord
rows.statement: def nodeCoord (l d : ℕ) : MIdx l d ≃ Fin (nodeCount l d)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeCoord_eq
rows.statement:
theorem nodeCoord_eq (l d : ℕ) : nodeCoord l d =
    (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight (fun k : Fin (d + 1) => tupleCoord l k.val)).trans
      finSigmaFinEquiv

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.auxCoord
rows.statement: def auxCoord (l d : ℕ) : TIdx l d ≃ Fin (auxCount l d)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.auxCoord_eq
rows.statement:
theorem auxCoord_eq (l d : ℕ) : auxCoord l d =
    (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight (fun k : Fin d => tupleCoord l (k.val + 1))).trans
      finSigmaFinEquiv

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.nodeCoord_root
rows.statement: theorem nodeCoord_root (l d : ℕ) : (nodeCoord l d (root l d)).val = 0

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.L1
rows.statement:
def L1 (C : PolyTensor p l n d) :
    Matrix (TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) (Fin l × MIdx l d) (ZMod (p : ℕ))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.L1_inl
rows.statement:
theorem L1_inl (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (v : TIdx l d) (i : Fin l) (u : MIdx l d) :
    L1 C (Sum.inl v) (i, u) =
      if u = parent v ∧ lastLabel v = i.castSucc then 1 else 0

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.L1_inr
rows.statement:
theorem L1_inr (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (j : Fin n) (iu : Fin l × MIdx l d) :
    L1 C (Sum.inr j) iu = 0

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.L0
rows.statement:
def L0 (C : PolyTensor p l n d) :
    Matrix (TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) (MIdx l d) (ZMod (p : ℕ))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.L0_inl
rows.statement:
theorem L0_inl (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (v : TIdx l d) (u : MIdx l d) :
    L0 C (Sum.inl v) u =
      (if u = parent v ∧ lastLabel v = Fin.last l then 1 else 0) -
        (if u = node v then 1 else 0)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.L0_inr
rows.statement:
theorem L0_inr (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (j : Fin n) (u : MIdx l d) :
    L0 C (Sum.inr j) u =
      ∑ tau : Fin d → Fin (l + 1), if u = leaf tau then C j tau else 0

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.matrix
rows.statement:
def matrix (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    Matrix (TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) (MIdx l d) (ZMod (p : ℕ))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.matrix_eq
rows.statement:
theorem matrix_eq (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    matrix C x = L1 C * PartialGarbling.publicTensor x + L0 C

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.matrix_inl
rows.statement:
theorem matrix_inl (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (v : TIdx l d) (u : MIdx l d) :
    matrix C x (Sum.inl v) u =
      (if u = parent v then xhat x (lastLabel v) else 0) -
        (if u = node v then 1 else 0)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.forward
rows.statement: def forward (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : MIdx l d) : ZMod (p : ℕ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.forward_eq
rows.statement:
theorem forward_eq (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : MIdx l d) :
    forward x u = ∏ i : Fin u.1.val, xhat x (u.2 i)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.forward_node
rows.statement:
theorem forward_node (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (v : TIdx l d) :
    forward x (node v) = forward x (parent v) * xhat x (lastLabel v)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.forward_root
rows.statement: theorem forward_root (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : forward x (root l d) = 1

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.rec
rows.statement:
def rec (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    (Fin n ⊕ MIdx l d) → ZMod (p : ℕ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.rec_inl
rows.statement:
theorem rec_inl (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (j : Fin n) :
    rec C x (Sum.inl j) = polyTensorEval C x j

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.rec_inr
rows.statement:
theorem rec_inr (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : MIdx l d) :
    rec C x (Sum.inr u) = forward x u

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.extend
rows.statement:
def extend (u : MIdx l d) (sigma : Fin (d - u.1.val) → Fin (l + 1)) :
    Fin d → Fin (l + 1)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.extend_eq
rows.statement:
theorem extend_eq (u : MIdx l d) (sigma : Fin (d - u.1.val) → Fin (l + 1)) :
    extend u sigma = fun i => Fin.append u.2 sigma
      (Fin.cast (Nat.add_sub_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ u.1.isLt)).symm i)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.backward
rows.statement:
def backward (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : MIdx l d) : ZMod (p : ℕ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.backward_eq
rows.statement:
theorem backward_eq (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (u : MIdx l d) :
    backward C x z u =
      ∑ sigma : Fin (d - u.1.val) → Fin (l + 1),
        (∑ j : Fin n, C j (extend u sigma) * z j) *
          ∏ i : Fin (d - u.1.val), xhat x (sigma i)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.shift
rows.statement:
def shift (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) : (TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.shift_inl
rows.statement:
theorem shift_inl (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (v : TIdx l d) :
    shift C x z (Sum.inl v) = backward C x z (node v)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.shift_inr
rows.statement:
theorem shift_inr (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (j : Fin n) : shift C x z (Sum.inr j) = z j

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.forward_action
rows.statement:
theorem forward_action (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    Matrix.mulVec (matrix C x) (forward x) =
      Sum.elim (fun _ : TIdx l d => 0) (polyTensorEval C x)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.backward_root
rows.statement:
theorem backward_root (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    backward C x z (root l d) = dotProduct z (polyTensorEval C x)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.backward_action
rows.statement:
theorem backward_action (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    Matrix.vecMul (shift C x z) (matrix C x) =
      fun u => if u = root l d then dotProduct z (polyTensorEval C x) else 0

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.rec_spec
rows.statement:
theorem rec_spec (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (t : (TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    dotProduct (PartialGarbling.pgbCore (L1 C) (L0 C) x z t) (rec C x) =
      dotProduct z (polyTensorEval C x)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.translation
rows.statement:
theorem translation (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (t : (TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) :
    PartialGarbling.pgbCore (L1 C) (L0 C) x z t =
      PartialGarbling.pgbStarCore (L1 C) (L0 C) (root l d) x
        (dotProduct z (polyTensorEval C x)) (t - shift C x z)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.PartialGarbling.Layered.privacy
rows.statement:
theorem privacy (C : PolyTensor p l n d) (x : Fin l → ZMod (p : ℕ))
    (z : Fin n → ZMod (p : ℕ)) (test : ((Fin n ⊕ MIdx l d) → ZMod (p : ℕ)) → ℝ) :
    ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample ((TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (PartialGarbling.pgbCore (L1 C) (L0 C) x z t)) =
      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample ((TIdx l d ⊕ Fin n) → ZMod (p : ℕ)))
        (fun t => test (PartialGarbling.pgbStarCore (L1 C) (L0 C) (root l d)
          x (dotProduct z (polyTensorEval C x)) t))

    [Ring R] (parent child : E → V) (weight : E → R) (values : V → R) :
    Matrix.mulVec
      (Matrix.of fun e v =>
        (if v = parent e then weight e else 0) -
          (if v = child e then 1 else 0)) values =
      fun e => weight e * values (parent e) - values (child e)

theorem weightedIncidence_vecMul {V E R : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq V]
    [Ring R] (parent child : E → V) (weight flow : E → R) :
    Matrix.vecMul flow
      (Matrix.of fun e v =>
        (if v = parent e then weight e else 0) -
          (if v = child e then 1 else 0)) =
      fun v =>
        (∑ e, if parent e = v then flow e * weight e else 0) -
          ∑ e, if child e = v then flow e else 0

structure SAChallenge (C : FnClass) (kappa : ℕ) where
  /-- The public challenge input. -/
  publicInput : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool
  /-- The private challenge input, hidden from the simulator. -/
  privateInput : Fin (C.privLen.eval kappa) → Bool

namespace FEScheme.Raw

/-- The real challenger records whether its one challenge has occurred. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.saImpl
rows.statement:
noncomputable def saImpl {sigma : Type} (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa)
    (challenge : (Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
      (Fin (C.privLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → sigma → ProbComp (Option (S.CT kappa pp) × sigma))
    (key : (Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → sigma →
      ProbComp (Option (S.SK kappa pp) × sigma)) :
    QueryImpl (S.saSpec kappa) sigma unifSpec
  | 0, xy, st => (challenge (S.saSplitChallenge kappa xy).1
      (S.saSplitChallenge kappa xy).2 st).bind fun o =>
      .pure (S.saCTAnswer kappa pp o.1, o.2)
  | 1, f, st => (key (S.saKeyFunction kappa f) st).bind fun o =>
      .pure (S.saSKAnswer kappa pp o.1, o.2)

/-- Oracle zero calls the typed challenge handler and encodes its optional answer. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.FEScheme.Raw.saImpl_zero_onSpec
rows.statement:
theorem saImpl_zero_onSpec {sigma : Type} (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa)
    (challenge : (Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
      (Fin (C.privLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → sigma → ProbComp (Option (S.CT kappa pp) × sigma))
    (key : (Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → sigma →
      ProbComp (Option (S.SK kappa pp) × sigma))
    (xy : (S.saSpec kappa).dom 0) (st : sigma) :
    S.saImpl kappa pp challenge key 0 xy st =
      (challenge (S.saSplitChallenge kappa xy).1 (S.saSplitChallenge kappa xy).2 st).bind
        fun o => .pure (S.saCTAnswer kappa pp o.1, o.2)

rows.statement:
theorem saImpl_one_onSpec {sigma : Type} (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa)
    (challenge : (Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
      (Fin (C.privLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → sigma → ProbComp (Option (S.CT kappa pp) × sigma))
    (key : (Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → sigma →
      ProbComp (Option (S.SK kappa pp) × sigma))
    (f : (S.saSpec kappa).dom 1) (st : sigma) :
    S.saImpl kappa pp challenge key 1 f st =
      (key (S.saKeyFunction kappa f) st).bind fun o =>
        .pure (S.saSKAnswer kappa pp o.1, o.2)

rows.statement:
noncomputable def realSAChallenge (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa)
    (pk : S.MPK kappa pp) (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool)
    (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval kappa) → Bool) :
    S.SAState kappa → ProbComp (Option (S.CT kappa pp) × S.SAState kappa)
  | none => (S.enc kappa pp pk x y).bind fun ct => .pure (some ct, some ⟨x, y⟩)
  | some a => .pure (none, some a)

/-- The first real challenge produces an honest ciphertext and records its inputs. -/

rows.statement:
theorem realSAChallenge_none (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa)

    (y : Fin (C.privLen.eval kappa) → Bool) :
    S.realSAChallenge kappa pp pk x y none =
      (S.enc kappa pp pk x y).bind fun ct => .pure (some ct, some ⟨x, y⟩)

rows.statement:
noncomputable def realSAKey (kappa : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa)

    S.SAState kappa → ProbComp (Option (S.SK kappa pp) × S.SAState kappa)

    S.saGame Sim A real kappa = (S.pubGen kappa).bind fun pp =>
      if real then
        (S.setup kappa pp).bind fun k =>
        (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval kappa) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
          Prod.fst <$> simulate (S.realSAImpl kappa pp k.1 k.2)
            (A.run kappa pp k.1 (List.ofFn r)) none
      else
        (Sim.setup kappa pp).bind fun k =>
        (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval kappa) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
          Prod.fst <$> simulate (S.idealSAImpl Sim kappa pp)
            (A.run kappa pp k.1 (List.ofFn r)) (k.2, none)

rows.statement:
structure SASimulator.Raw where
  /-- The simulator state over the drawn public parameters. -/
  St : (kappa : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G kappa → Type
  /-- The canonical state word used by uniform efficiency. -/
  encSt : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → St kappa pp → List Bool
  /-- State encodings lose no information. -/
  encSt_injective : ∀ kappa pp, Function.Injective (encSt kappa pp)
  /-- The complete setup draw. -/
  SetupDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → PublicParams S.G kappa → Type
  /-- Setup draws are finite. -/
  [setupFinite : ∀ kappa pp, Fintype (SetupDraw kappa pp)]
  /-- Setup draws are nonempty. -/
  [setupNonempty : ∀ kappa pp, Nonempty (SetupDraw kappa pp)]
  /-- Setup generates the simulated public key and initial private state. -/
  setupCore : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → SetupDraw kappa pp →
    S.MPK kappa pp × St kappa pp
  /-- The complete ciphertext draw depends on the state and public input only. -/
  EncDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → St kappa pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → Type
  /-- Ciphertext draws are finite. -/
  [encFinite : ∀ kappa pp st x, Fintype (EncDraw kappa pp st x)]
  /-- Ciphertext draws are nonempty. -/
  [encNonempty : ∀ kappa pp st x, Nonempty (EncDraw kappa pp st x)]
  /-- Ciphertext simulation never receives the private challenge input. -/
  encCore : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → EncDraw kappa pp st x →
    S.CT kappa pp × St kappa pp
  /-- One key's complete draw depends on its state, public input, function and value. -/
  KeyDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → St kappa pp →
    (Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → (Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
    C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp) → Type
  /-- Key-simulation draws are finite. -/
  [keyFinite : ∀ kappa pp st x f mu, Fintype (KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu)]
  /-- Key-simulation draws are nonempty. -/
  [keyNonempty : ∀ kappa pp st x f mu, Nonempty (KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu)]
  /-- Key simulation receives exactly the public input, function and allowed scalar. -/
  keyCore : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) → KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu →
    S.SK kappa pp × St kappa pp
  /-- Encode a complete setup draw. -/
  encSetupDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → SetupDraw kappa pp → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete ciphertext-simulation draw. -/
  encEncDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → EncDraw kappa pp st x → List Bool
  /-- Encode a complete key-simulation draw. -/
  encKeyDraw : (kappa : ℕ) → (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) → (st : St kappa pp) →
    (x : Fin (C.pubLen.eval kappa) → Bool) → (f : Fin (C.fnLen.eval kappa) → Bool) →
    (mu : C.Out kappa (S.cprm kappa pp)) → KeyDraw kappa pp st x f mu → List Bool

rows.statement:
structure SASimulator extends SASimulator.Raw S where
  /-- Setup and its encoded public key/state output are uniformly efficient. -/
  setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun kappa (pp : PublicParams S.G kappa) => pp.encode) encSetupDraw
    (fun kappa pp (o : S.MPK kappa pp × St kappa pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encMPK kappa pp o.1)) (encSt kappa pp o.2)) setupCore
  /-- Public-input-only ciphertext simulation is uniformly efficient. -/
  enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.encInputWord
    (fun kappa pi => encEncDraw kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput)
    (fun kappa pi (o : S.CT kappa pi.pp × St kappa pi.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encCT kappa pi.pp o.1)) (encSt kappa pi.pp o.2))
    (fun kappa pi => encCore kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput)
  /-- Key simulation is uniformly efficient with all permitted inputs on its word. -/
  key_eff : SamplesEfficiently toRaw.keyInputWord
    (fun kappa pi => encKeyDraw kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput pi.function pi.value)
    (fun kappa pi (o : S.SK kappa pi.pp × St kappa pi.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn (S.encSK kappa pi.pp o.1)) (encSt kappa pi.pp o.2))
    (fun kappa pi => keyCore kappa pi.pp pi.state pi.publicInput pi.function pi.value)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.TwoStage
rows.statement:
structure TwoStage where
  /-- The commitment machine. -/
  first : NUPPT
  /-- The final distinguishing machine. -/
  second : NUPPT

/-- A commitment contains both inputs, the ordered function descriptions, and arbitrary
first-stage state [GJLS21, Definition 4.3]. The key count is the polynomial budget. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Commitment
rows.statement:
structure Commitment (C : FnClass) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- The public challenge input. -/
  publicInput : Fin (C.pubLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The private challenge input. -/
  privateInput : Fin (C.privLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- All committed function descriptions. -/
  functions : Fin (q.eval κ) → Fin (C.fnLen.eval κ) → Bool
  /-- The first machine's retained state. -/
  state : List Bool

namespace Commitment

variable {C : FnClass} {q : PolyExpr} {κ : ℕ}

/-- Decode successive public, private and function windows, followed by an arbitrary state
suffix. Missing input bits are false. This total parser imposes no validity restriction on
non-uniform adversaries [GJLS21, Definition 4.3]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Commitment.decode
rows.statement:
def decode (C : FnClass) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Commitment C q κ where
  publicInput i

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Commitment.decode_eq
rows.statement:
theorem decode_eq (C : FnClass) (q : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (w : List Bool) :
    decode C q κ w =
      ⟨(fun i => w.getD i.val false),
        (fun i => w.getD (C.pubLen.eval κ + i.val) false),
        (fun j i => w.getD
          (C.pubLen.eval κ + C.privLen.eval κ + j.val * C.fnLen.eval κ + i.val) false),
        w.drop (C.pubLen.eval κ + C.privLen.eval κ + q.eval κ * C.fnLen.eval κ)⟩

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Commitment.omega
TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Commitment.omega_eq
rows.statement:
theorem omega_eq (a : Commitment C q κ) (S : FEScheme.Raw C)
    (pp : PublicParams S.G κ) :
    a.omega S pp = ⟨q.eval κ, a.publicInput, a.functions,
      fun j => C.eval κ (S.cprm κ pp) (a.functions j) a.publicInput a.privateInput⟩

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.MPK
rows.statement:
structure MPK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The two-by-three implicit matrix. -/
  A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 3) pp.group.G
  /-- The implicit private-input mask. -/
  AW : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The implicit public-variable mask. -/
  AU : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) pp.group.G
  /-- The implicit constant mask. -/
  AV : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) pp.group.G

/-- Π's master secret consists of its three scalar masking matrices
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Setup]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.MSK
rows.statement:
structure MSK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The private-input masking matrix. -/
  W : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The public-variable masking matrix. -/
  U : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The constant masking matrix. -/
  V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)

/-- Π's ciphertext has its three source-group blocks, with the public input supplied
separately to decryption [Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Enc]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.CT
rows.statement:
structure CT (G : BilinearGen) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The three-coordinate mask `[sA]`. -/
  c0 : Fin 3 → pp.group.G
  /-- The masked private input. -/
  c1 : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G
  /-- The two-coordinate public-input mask. -/
  c2 : Fin 2 → pp.group.G

/-- A function key contains the three garbling blocks and `[R]`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, KeyGen]. The function and its group matrix are explicit key metadata. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.Key
rows.statement:
structure Key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) where
  /-- The three-by-output first block. -/
  K1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The public-variable garbling block. -/
  K2 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G
  /-- The constant garbling block. -/
  K3 : Matrix (Fin 3) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G
  /-- The two-row reconstruction mask. -/
  R : Matrix (Fin 2) (PG.MIdx κ pp.orderParam f) pp.group.G

/-- Setup's single draw contains independent uniform `A,W,U,V`
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 9, Setup]. -/

rows.statement:
theorem setupDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp =
      (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 3) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order) ×
        Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order))

rows.statement:

structure RawAlgorithms (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Honest setup core. -/
  setupCore : SetupDraw G ℓ zDim κ pp → MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp × MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp
  /-- Honest encryption core on a source-group private vector. -/
  encCore : MPK G ℓ zDim κ pp → (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    (Fin (zDim.eval κ) → pp.group.G) → EncDraw G κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp
  /-- Honest function-dependent key-generation core. -/
  keyCore : MSK G ℓ zDim κ pp → (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) →
    Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G →
    KeyDraw G PG κ pp f → Key G PG κ pp f
  /-- Deterministic decryption in the target group. -/
  dec : (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) →
    Matrix (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (Fin (n'.eval κ)) pp.group.G →
    (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) → Key G PG κ pp f → CT G zDim κ pp → pp.group.GT

/-- Run the typed next-move adversary through the shared bounded oracle computation.

structure SAState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- No key is answered before this challenge is committed. -/
  challenge : Option (Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp)
  /-- The next unused per-key tape block. -/
  used : ℕ

/-- A deterministic stateful protocol refuses repeated challenges, keys before the
challenge, and keys exceeding the total call budget. Technical oracle glue. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.protocolHandler
rows.statement:
def protocolHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp → KeyPack G PG κ pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp →
      (saSpec G PG zDim κ pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
    | some _ => (none, st)
  | true, query, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (none, st)
    | some msg => if st.used < q then
        (some (makeKey st.used msg query), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
      else (none, st)

/-- The challenge branch either commits once or returns none without changing state. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.protocolHandler_challenge
rows.statement:
theorem protocolHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp → KeyPack G PG κ pp)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G PG zDim q κ pp makeCT makeKey false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
      | some _ => (none, st)

theorem protocolHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr}
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → CT G zDim κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ zDim κ pp → KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp → KeyPack G PG κ pp)
    (query : KeyQuery G PG zDim κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ zDim κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G PG zDim q κ pp makeCT makeKey true query st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (none, st)
      | some msg => if st.used < q then
          (some (makeKey st.used msg query), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
        else (none, st)

    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr)
    (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) :

      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (red0 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (red1 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 1)) →
      ∀ κ, freshSaSimAdv G PG zDim A κ ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) (D 0) κ +
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) (D 1) κ + linearSlack G κ

    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (ω : SecurityDraw G PG zDim A.budget κ pp)
    (r : List Bool) :

          (setupAt G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ω).1
          (setupAt G PG zDim A.budget κ pp ω).2.1).det = 0 then false

      runGameDet G PG zDim A 2 true κ pp ω r

    (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) (κ : ℕ) :
    saSimAdv G PG zDim A κ ≤
      advantage (game G PG zDim A 0 κ) (game G PG zDim A 1 κ) +
      advantage (game G PG zDim A 2 κ) (game G PG zDim A 5 κ) + linearSlack G κ

rows.statement:
theorem linear_saSimAdv_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ n' : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ n' Fn) (zDim : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G PG zDim) :
    ∃ ω : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Advice PG zDim A.budget p κ, ∀ D : Fin 2 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (red0 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (red1 G PG zDim p hp A (ω 1)) →
      ∀ κ, saSimAdv G PG zDim A κ ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) (D 0) κ +
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) (D 1) κ + linearSlack G κ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.SimState
rows.statement:
structure SimState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ zDim : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The three-by-two public-key basis. -/
  A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The private-input mask. -/
  W : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (zDim.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The public-variable mask. -/
  U : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) × Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The constant mask. -/
  V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- The ideal three-coordinate ciphertext mask. -/
  c : Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- The ideal private-input ciphertext mask. -/
  w : Fin (zDim.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- The ideal public-input ciphertext mask. -/
  v : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- The total inverse of the transposed augmentation. -/
  basisInv : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) (ZMod pp.group.order)

/-- Simulator setup draws `A,c,W,U,V,w,v` independently and uniformly
[Wee20, §4.2, p. 10, Setup*]. -/

      ⟨pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.c, pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.w,
        pp.group.expVec pp.generator st.v⟩

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Linear.combineRows_eq

theorem combineRows_eq (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) {J : Type}
    (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) (ZMod pp.group.order)) (a : Fin 3 → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) J pp.group.G) (lo : J → pp.group.G) :
    combineRows G κ pp C a hi lo = matMulGroup C hi ⊙ (fun i j => lo j ^ (a i).val)

theorem rankSlack_eq {G : BilinearGen} {κ : ℕ} (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    rankSlack pp = 1 - (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ)) *
      (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ) ^ 2) * (1 - 1 / (pp.group.order : ℝ) ^ 3)

      (fun ω => IsUnit (basisMatrix G κ pp ω.1 ω.2.1).det) = 1 - rankSlack pp

    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (acc : Option (QueryLog ((S).saSpec κ)))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.PHFE.replayStep_eq
rows.statement:
theorem replayStep_eq (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (acc : Option (QueryLog ((S).saSpec κ)))
    (entry : Σ i, (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).dom i ×
      (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)).rng i) :
    replayStep G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r acc entry =
      acc.bind fun hist =>
        match A.next κ pp ((mpkEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm pk) r hist, entry with
        | .query 0 xy, ⟨false, query, answer⟩ =>
            if decodeChallenge G ℓ n d PG κ pp xy = query then
              some (hist ++ [⟨0, xy, (S).saCTAnswer κ pp
                (answer.map (ctEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm)⟩])
            else none
        | .query 1 f, ⟨true, query, answer⟩ =>
            if decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) ((S).saKeyFunction κ f) = query then
              let wireAnswer

def quadraticNext (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp))) :
    Move (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp)) Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.PHFE.quadraticNext_eq
rows.statement:
theorem quadraticNext_eq (A : (S).SAAdv) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G ℓ n n κ (params κ pp)) (r : List Bool)
    (hist : QueryLog (Quadratic.saSpec G n n PG κ (params κ pp))) :
    quadraticNext G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist =
      match replay G ℓ n d PG A κ pp pk r hist with
      | none => .ret false
      | some wire => match A.next κ pp ((mpkEquiv G ℓ n d PG κ pp).symm pk) r wire with
        | .ret b => .ret b
        | .query 0 xy => .query false (decodeChallenge G ℓ n d PG κ pp xy)
        | .query 1 f => .query true
            (decodeFunction G ℓ n d κ (params κ pp) ((S).saKeyFunction κ f))

theorem wee20PHFE_saSimAdv_le (hPG : PHFE.PGSound PG) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : (S).SAAdv) :
    ∃ φ : ∀ κ, Quadratic.MaskAdvice n n p κ,
    ∃ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) A.budget p κ,
    ∃ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Quadratic.Advice n n A.budget PG p κ,
    ∀ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 1)) →
      (D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) A.coins
        (Quadratic.red2 G n n PG p hp (Q A) (ωOuter 0)) →
      (D 3).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) A.coins
        (Quadratic.red3 G n n PG p hp (Q A) (ωOuter 1)) →
      ∀ κ, (S).saSimAdv (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG) A κ ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) (D 0) κ +
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) (D 1) κ +
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) n (D 2) κ + G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) n (D 3) κ +
        Linear.linearSlack G κ

    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : (S).SAAdv) :
    ∃ φ : ∀ κ, Quadratic.MaskAdvice n n p κ,
    ∃ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) A.budget p κ,
    ∃ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Quadratic.Advice n n A.budget PG p κ,
    ∀ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (Quadratic.piDim n n) p hp
          (Quadratic.toLinear G n n PG p hp (Q A) φ) (ωPi 1)) →
      (D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n) A.coins

      ∀ κ, (S).saSimAdv (wee20SASim_raw G ℓ n d PG) A κ ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 4, ((Quadratic.hopCols ℓ i).eval κ : ℝ) * G.dlinAdv (B i) κ) +

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.MPK
rows.statement:
structure MPK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The first public group mask. -/
  A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The second public group mask. -/
  A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The linear building block's public key. -/
  linear : Linear.MPK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp

/-- The master key retains Π's secret key and the fixed PUBLIC group matrix needed by
per-key Π.KeyGen [Wee20, §3.1, p. 6; §4, p. 8, per-key matrix form]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.MSK
rows.statement:
structure MSK (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The fixed public group matrix. -/
  matrix : Matrix (Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ)) (Fin ((n1.mul n2).eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The linear master secret key. -/
  linear : Linear.MSK G ℓ (piDim n1 n2) κ pp

/-- The ciphertext contains the two group masks and Π's ciphertext
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Enc]. The public input remains separate. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.CT
rows.statement:
structure CT (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- The first masked private vector. -/
  y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → pp.group.G
  /-- The second masked private vector. -/
  y2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → pp.group.G
  /-- The linear ciphertext for the group signal. -/
  linear : Linear.CT G (piDim n1 n2) κ pp

/-- A function key stores the public matrix metadata and the linear function key
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6, Dec; §4, p. 8]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.Key
rows.statement:
structure Key (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) {ℓ : PolyExpr} {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) where
  /-- The fixed public matrix, needed without a public-key argument to decryption. -/
  matrix : Matrix (Fin ((piDim n1 n2).eval κ)) (Fin ((n1.mul n2).eval κ)) pp.group.G
  /-- The linear key for this function and matrix. -/
  linear : Linear.Key G PG κ pp f

/-- Setup draws its two scalar public masks and the linear setup randomness
[Wee20, §3.1, p. 6]. -/

    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)
    (sk : Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f) (ct : CT G n1 n2 κ pp) :

      groupDot (fun i => pp.group.pairTensor ct.y1 ct.y2 (finProdFinEquiv.symm i))

        (Linear.dec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp f sk.matrix x sk.linear ct.linear)⁻¹

    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Honest setup core. -/
  setupCore : SetupDraw G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp × MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp
  /-- Honest encryption core. -/
  encCore : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    (Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) → (Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    EncDraw G κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp
  /-- Honest function-key core. -/
  keyCore : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) →
    Linear.KeyDraw G PG κ pp f → Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f
  /-- Deterministic decryption. -/
  dec : (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) → (Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) →
    Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f → CT G n1 n2 κ pp → pp.group.GT
