rows.statement:
theorem hopCols_eq (ℓ : PolyExpr) (i : Fin 4) :
    hopCols ℓ i = if i.val = 1 then ℓ else .const 1

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.hopRows
rows.statement:
def hopRows {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr) {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (i : Fin 4) : PolyExpr

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.hopRows_eq
rows.statement:
theorem hopRows_eq {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr) {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type}
    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (i : Fin 4) : hopRows n1 n2 q PG i =
      if i.val = 0 then .const 3 else if i.val = 1 then PG.mBound.mul q
        else if i.val = 2 then n1 else n2

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.quadraticSlack
rows.statement: noncomputable def quadraticSlack (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (κ : ℕ) : ℝ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.quadraticSlack_eq
rows.statement:
theorem quadraticSlack_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ : PolyExpr) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (κ : ℕ) :
    quadraticSlack G ℓ p κ = Linear.linearSlack G κ +
      3 * BilinearGen.mddhSlack p (PolyExpr.const 1) κ + BilinearGen.mddhSlack p ℓ κ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.mddh_sum_le
rows.statement:
theorem mddh_sum_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (D : Fin 4 → NUPPT) :
    ∃ η : ∀ i : Fin 4, ∀ κ,
      BilinearGen.MddhAdvice p (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 q PG i) κ,
    ∀ B : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (∀ i, (B i).RealizesOn G.dlinEnc (D i).coins
        (G.dlinToMddh p hp (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 q PG i) (D i) (η i))) →
      ∀ κ, (∑ i : Fin 4, G.mddhAdv (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 q PG i) (D i) κ) ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 4, ((hopCols ℓ i).eval κ : ℝ) * G.dlinAdv (B i) κ) +
        3 * BilinearGen.mddhSlack p (PolyExpr.const 1) κ + BilinearGen.mddhSlack p ℓ κ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.quadratic_saSimAdv_dlin_le
rows.statement:
theorem quadratic_saSimAdv_dlin_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) :
    ∃ φ : ∀ κ, MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ,
    ∃ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (piDim n1 n2) A.budget p κ,
    ∃ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Advice n1 n2 A.budget PG p κ,
    ∀ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (piDim n1 n2) p hp (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A φ) (ωPi 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (piDim n1 n2) p hp (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A φ) (ωPi 1)) →
      (D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n1) A.coins
        (red2 G n1 n2 PG p hp A (ωOuter 0)) →
      (D 3).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n2) A.coins
        (red3 G n1 n2 PG p hp A (ωOuter 1)) →
    ∃ η : ∀ i : Fin 4, ∀ κ,
      BilinearGen.MddhAdvice p (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 A.budget PG i) κ,
    ∀ B : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (∀ i, (B i).RealizesOn G.dlinEnc (D i).coins
        (G.dlinToMddh p hp (hopCols ℓ i) (hopRows n1 n2 A.budget PG i) (D i) (η i))) →
      ∀ κ, freshSaSimAdv G n1 n2 PG A κ ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 4, ((hopCols ℓ i).eval κ : ℝ) * G.dlinAdv (B i) κ) +
        quadraticSlack G ℓ p κ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.SAAdv
rows.statement:
structure SAAdv (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) where
  /-- Shared adversary coin length. -/
  coins : PolyExpr
  /-- TOTAL call budget, including the challenge. -/
  budget : PolyExpr
  /-- Next move after the current typed history. -/
  next : ∀ κ (pp : PublicParams G κ), MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → List Bool →
    QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) → Move (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) Bool

/-- Run the outer adversary through the shared bounded interpreter, with no added call
[Wee20, §2.2, p. 5]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.SAAdv.run
rows.statement:
def SAAdv.run (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    OracleComp (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.SAAdv.run_eq
rows.statement:
theorem SAAdv.run_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp pk r =
      buildComp (A.next κ pp pk r) false (A.budget.eval κ) []

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.SAState
rows.statement:
structure SAState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Committed challenge, absent until the unique accepted challenge call. -/
  challenge : Option (Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
  /-- Accepted-key counter. -/
  used : ℕ

/-- This deterministic protocol refuses pre-challenge keys, repeated challenges and keys
beyond the total cap [Wee20, §2.2, p. 5, with explicit total behavior]. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.protocolHandler
rows.statement:
def protocolHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → Fn κ pp.orderParam → KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp) :
    ∀ i, (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp).dom i → SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp →
      (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp).rng i × SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
    | some _ => (none, st)
  | true, f, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => (none, st)
    | some msg => if st.used < q then
        (some (makeKey st.used msg f), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
      else (none, st)

/-- A challenge commits once and otherwise leaves state unchanged. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.protocolHandler_challenge
rows.statement:
theorem protocolHandler_challenge (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → Fn κ pp.orderParam → KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp)
    (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (st : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G n1 n2 PG q κ pp makeCT makeKey false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (some (makeCT msg), ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)
      | some _ => (none, st)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.protocolHandler_key
rows.statement:
theorem protocolHandler_key (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (q κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (makeCT : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → CT G n1 n2 κ pp)
    (makeKey : ℕ → Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp → Fn κ pp.orderParam → KeyPack G n1 n2 PG κ pp)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (st : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    protocolHandler G n1 n2 PG q κ pp makeCT makeKey true f st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => (none, st)
      | some msg => if st.used < q then
          (some (makeKey st.used msg f), ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)
        else (none, st)

rows.statement: abbrev MaskDraw (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.maskDraw_eq
rows.statement:
theorem maskDraw_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)

      (Fin ((maskCount n1 n2).eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.Masks
rows.statement:
structure Masks (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- First public mask. -/
  A1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n1.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- Second public mask. -/
  A2 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin (n2.eval κ)) (ZMod pp.group.order)
  /-- Honest first encryption seed. -/
  s1 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- Honest second encryption seed. -/
  s2 : Fin 2 → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- Independent first simulated vector. -/
  y1 : Fin (n1.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order
  /-- Independent second simulated vector. -/
  y2 : Fin (n2.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order

/-- Total coordinate access defaults to zero beyond the allocated tape. Technical glue. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.maskAt
rows.statement:
def maskAt (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp) (i : ℕ) : ZMod pp.group.order

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.maskAt_eq
rows.statement:
theorem maskAt_eq (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (ω : MaskDraw G n1 n2 κ pp) (i : ℕ) : maskAt G n1 n2 κ pp ω i =
      if h : i < (maskCount n1 n2).eval κ then ω ⟨i, h⟩ else 0

def masksAt (G : BilinearGen) (n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)

TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.wrapLinearCT_eq
rows.statement:
theorem wrapLinearCT_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (ct : Linear.CT G (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) : wrapLinearCT G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp m msg ct =
      ⟨pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul m.s1 m.A1 + msg.2.1),
        pp.group.expVec pp.generator (Matrix.vecMul m.s2 m.A2 + msg.2.2), ct⟩

theorem wrapLinearKey_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)

rows.statement:
def replayLinear (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (m : Masks G n1 n2 κ pp) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (r : List Bool) :
    QueryLog (Linear.saSpec G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp) →
      QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) → Option (QueryLog (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp))
  | [], h => some h
  | e :: es, h => match A.next κ pp pk r h, e with
    | .query false msg, ⟨false, pair⟩ =>
        let answer

rows.statement:
theorem derivedNext_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)

noncomputable def freshRealHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (pk : MPK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    QueryImpl (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) (SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) unifSpec
  | false, msg, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (enc G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk msg.1 msg.2.1
      msg.2.2))
    | some _ => .pure (none, st)
  | true, f, st => match st.challenge with
    | none => .pure (none, st)
    | some _ => if st.used < q.eval κ then
        ((fun key => (some ⟨f, key⟩, ⟨st.challenge, st.used + 1⟩)) <$> (keyGen G n1 n2 PG κ pp msk
          f))
      else .pure (none, st)

/-- A real challenge samples the actual honest encryption draw exactly once. -/

    (msk : MSK G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (msg : Challenge G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (st : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    freshRealHandler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp pk msk false msg st =
      match st.challenge with
      | none => ((fun ct => (some ct, ⟨some msg, st.used⟩)) <$> (enc G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp pk msg.1 msg.2.1
        msg.2.2))
      | some _ => .pure (none, st)

rows.statement:
structure FreshIdealState (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n1 n2 : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ)
    (pp : PublicParams G κ) where
  /-- Challenge and accepted-key counter. -/
  protocol : SAState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp
  /-- Persistent simulator state. -/
  simulator : SimState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp

/-- Ideal accepted queries invoke actual stateful simulator calls
[Wee20, §3.2, p. 7]. The key's allowed value is exponentiated from the known scalar
function value; no target-to-source conversion is attempted. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.freshIdealHandler
rows.statement:
noncomputable def freshIdealHandler (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 q : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) :
    QueryImpl (saSpec G n1 n2 PG κ pp) (FreshIdealState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) unifSpec
  | false, msg, st => match st.protocol.challenge with
    | none => ((fun out => (some out.1, ⟨⟨some msg, st.protocol.used⟩, out.2⟩)) <$> (simEnc G ℓ n1
      n2 κ pp st.simulator msg.1))
    | some _ => .pure (none, st)
  | true, f, st => match st.protocol.challenge with
    | none => .pure (none, st)
    | some msg => if st.protocol.used < q.eval κ then
        ((fun key => (some ⟨f, key⟩,
            ⟨⟨st.protocol.challenge, st.protocol.used + 1⟩, st.simulator⟩)) <$> (simKey G n1 n2 PG κ
              pp st.simulator f msg.1
          (pp.generator ^ (value G n1 n2 PG κ pp f msg.1 msg.2.1 msg.2.2).val)))
      else .pure (none, st)

/-- Ideal encryption saves precisely the state returned by the actual simulator. -/

    (st : FreshIdealState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) :
    freshIdealHandler G n1 n2 q PG κ pp false msg st =
      match st.protocol.challenge with
      | none => ((fun out => (some out.1, ⟨⟨some msg, st.protocol.used⟩, out.2⟩)) <$> (simEnc G ℓ n1
        n2 κ pp st.simulator msg.1))
      | some _ => .pure (none, st)

    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.freshSaGame_eq
rows.statement:
theorem freshSaGame_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) (ideal : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : freshSaGame G n1 n2 PG A ideal κ =
      (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin (A.coins.eval κ) → Bool)).bind fun r =>
      if ideal then (simSetup G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
        ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshIdealHandler G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp)
          (SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r))
          ⟨⟨none, 0⟩, ctx.2⟩))
      else (setup G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp).bind fun ctx =>
        ((Prod.fst) <$> (simulate (freshRealHandler G n1 n2 A.budget PG κ pp ctx.1 ctx.2)
          (SAAdv.run G n1 n2 PG A κ pp ctx.1 (List.ofFn r)) ⟨none, 0⟩))

rows.statement:
theorem quadratic_saSimAdv_le (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (p : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (A : SAAdv G n1 n2 PG) :
    ∃ φ : ∀ κ, MaskAdvice n1 n2 p κ,
    ∃ ωPi : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Linear.Advice PG (piDim n1 n2) A.budget p κ,
    ∃ ωOuter : Fin 2 → ∀ κ, Advice n1 n2 A.budget PG p κ,
    ∀ D : Fin 4 → NUPPT,
      (D 0).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3)) A.coins
        (Linear.red0 G PG (piDim n1 n2) p hp (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A φ) (ωPi 0)) →
      (D 1).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget)) A.coins
        (Linear.red1 G PG (piDim n1 n2) p hp (toLinear G n1 n2 PG p hp A φ) (ωPi 1)) →
      (D 2).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n1) A.coins
        (red2 G n1 n2 PG p hp A (ωOuter 0)) →
      (D 3).RealizesOn (G.mddhEnc (PolyExpr.const 1) n2) A.coins
        (red3 G n1 n2 PG p hp A (ωOuter 1)) →
      ∀ κ, freshSaSimAdv G n1 n2 PG A κ ≤
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) (PolyExpr.const 3) (D 0) κ +
        G.mddhAdv ℓ (PG.mBound.mul A.budget) (D 1) κ +
        G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) n1 (D 2) κ + G.mddhAdv (PolyExpr.const 1) n2 (D 3) κ +
        Linear.linearSlack G κ

    (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (st : SimState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp) (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam)
    (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (mu : pp.group.G)
    (ω : Linear.SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f) : Key G n1 n2 PG κ pp f

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.Quadratic.simKeyCore_eq
rows.statement:
theorem simKeyCore_eq (G : BilinearGen) {ℓ : PolyExpr} (n1 n2 : PolyExpr)
    {Fn : ℕ → ℕ+ → Type} (PG : PartialGarbling.Raw ℓ (n1.mul n2) Fn)
    (κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ) (st : SimState G ℓ n1 n2 κ pp)
    (f : Fn κ pp.orderParam) (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod pp.group.order) (mu : pp.group.G)
    (ω : Linear.SimKeyDraw G PG κ pp f) :
    simKeyCore G n1 n2 PG κ pp st f x mu ω =
      ⟨st.matrix, Linear.simKeyCore G PG (piDim n1 n2) κ pp st.linear f st.matrix x
        (crossLeak G n1 n2 PG κ pp st f x mu) ω⟩

structure Targets (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) : Prop where
  /-- The five honest-algorithm targets. -/
  scheme : SchemeTargets G ℓ n d
  /-- Both concrete simulators' targets. -/
  simulators : SimTargets G ℓ n d
  /-- Deterministic layered matrix generation and reconstruction targets. -/
  garbling : PGTargets ℓ (n.mul n) d
  /-- The one uniform linear-time encryption target. -/
  linear : LinearEfficient G
  /-- Uniform L1 matrix-DH preprocessing. -/
  mddh : MddhPreTargets G

/-- All targets are exactly their displayed conjunction. -/

theorem targets_iff (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n : PolyExpr) (d : ℕ) : Targets G ℓ n d ↔
    SchemeTargets G ℓ n d ∧ SimTargets G ℓ n d ∧ PGTargets ℓ (n.mul n) d ∧
      LinearEfficient G ∧ MddhPreTargets G

structure PGTargets : Prop where
  /-- One uniform map computes both matrices from the supplied modulus and tensor. -/
  lgen_eff : ∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
    ∀ κ (p : ℕ+) (f : PolyTensor p (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ) d),
      a ((PG).lgenInput κ p f) = (PG).encLgen κ p f
  /-- One uniform map computes reconstruction from the supplied modulus and public input. -/
  rec_eff : ∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
    ∀ κ (p : ℕ+) (f : PolyTensor p (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ) d)
      (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod (p : ℕ)),
      a ((PG).recInput κ p f x) = (PG).encRec κ p f x

/-- The target is exactly the conjunction of its displayed algorithm obligations. -/

rows.statement:
theorem pgTargets_iff :
    PGTargets ℓ n d ↔
      (∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
        ∀ κ (p : ℕ+) (f : PolyTensor p (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ) d),
          a ((PG).lgenInput κ p f) = (PG).encLgen κ p f) ∧
      (∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
        ∀ κ (p : ℕ+) (f : PolyTensor p (ℓ.eval κ) (n.eval κ) d)
          (x : Fin (ℓ.eval κ) → ZMod (p : ℕ)),
          a ((PG).recInput κ p f x) = (PG).encRec κ p f x)

    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) (PolyExpr.const n) κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (y : Fin ((phfeClass (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ω : Quadratic.EncDraw G κ pp) : List Bool

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.PHFE.linearEncInput_eq
rows.statement:
theorem linearEncInput_eq (G : BilinearGen) (ℓ n d κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
    (pk : Quadratic.MPK G (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) (PolyExpr.const n) κ pp)
    (x : Fin ((phfeClass (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (y : Fin ((phfeClass (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool)
    (ω : Quadratic.EncDraw G κ pp) :
    linearEncInput G ℓ n d κ pp pk x y ω = NUPPT.advInput κ
      (pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size ℓ) ℓ)
        (pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (Nat.size n) n)
          (pairEncode pp.encode
            (pairEncode (List.ofFn (encMPK G (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) κ pp pk))
              (pairEncode (List.ofFn x)
                (pairEncode (List.ofFn y) (Wire.quadraticEncDraw pp ω)))))))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.linearEfficient_iff
rows.statement:
theorem linearEfficient_iff (G : BilinearGen) : LinearEfficient G ↔
    ∃ M : FinTM Bool, ∃ q : PolyExpr, ∀ (ℓ n d κ : ℕ) (pp : PublicParams G κ)
      (pk : Quadratic.MPK G (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) (PolyExpr.const n) κ pp)
      (x : Fin ((phfeClass (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) G.wG d).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool)
      (y : Fin ((phfeClass (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) G.wG d).privLen.eval κ) → Bool)
      (ω : Quadratic.EncDraw G κ pp), 0 < ℓ + n →
      M.ComputesInTime (PHFE.linearEncInput G ℓ n d κ pp pk x y ω)
        (List.ofFn (PHFE.encCT G (PolyExpr.const n) κ pp
          (PHFE.encCore G (PolyExpr.const ℓ) (PolyExpr.const n) d κ pp pk x y ω))) ((ℓ + n) * q.eval
            κ)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.mddhPreTargets_iff
rows.statement:
theorem mddhPreTargets_iff (G : BilinearGen) : MddhPreTargets G ↔
    ∀ (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ) (d ℓ : PolyExpr) (_D : NUPPT),
      ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧
        ∀ κ (ω : BilinearGen.MddhAdvice p d ℓ κ) (c : G.DLINChallenge κ),
          f (pairEncode (G.mddhAdviceEnc p hp d ℓ κ ω) (G.dlinEnc κ c)) =
            G.mddhPre p hp d ℓ κ ω c

    G.MDDHRealizable p hp d ℓ

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.SchemeTargets
rows.statement:
structure SchemeTargets : Prop where
  /-- Uniformly draw the nonidentity public generator after the group description. -/
  pubGen_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (g : GroupDescription (S).G κ) => g.val)
    (fun κ g (r : GeneratorDraw (S).G κ g) => List.ofFn (((S).G.group κ g.val).encG r.val))
    (fun κ _ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) => pp.encode) (publicParamsCore (S).G)
  /-- Uniformly sample the complete honest setup draw and encode both keys. -/
  setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) => pp.encode) (S).encSetupDraw
    (fun κ pp (o : (S).MPK κ pp × (S).MSK κ pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMPK κ pp o.1)) (List.ofFn ((S).encMSK κ pp o.2))) (S).setupCore
  /-- Uniformly sample encryption with pp, the public key, and both inputs supplied. -/
  enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams (S).G κ,
        (S).MPK κ pp × (Fin ((C).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) × (Fin ((C).privLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
      pairEncode π.1.encode (pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMPK κ π.1 π.2.1))
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn π.2.2.1) (List.ofFn π.2.2.2))))
    (fun κ π => (S).encEncDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)
    (fun κ π (o : (S).CT κ π.1) => List.ofFn ((S).encCT κ π.1 o))
    (fun κ π => (S).encCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)
  /-- Uniformly sample a function key with pp, the master key, and function supplied. -/
  keyGen_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams (S).G κ, (S).MSK κ pp × (Fin ((C).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
      pairEncode π.1.encode
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMSK κ π.1 π.2.1)) (List.ofFn π.2.2)))
    (fun κ π => (S).encKeyDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)
    (fun κ π (o : (S).SK κ π.1) => List.ofFn ((S).encSK κ π.1 o))
    (fun κ π => (S).keyCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)
  /-- One polynomial-time map computes deterministic decryption at every public group. -/
  dec_eff : ∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
    ∀ κ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) (sk : (S).SK κ pp)
      (x : Fin ((C).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (ct : (S).CT κ pp),
      a (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode pp.encode
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encSK κ pp sk))
          (pairEncode (List.ofFn x) (List.ofFn ((S).encCT κ pp ct)))))) =
        match (S).dec κ pp sk x ct with
        | none => [false]
        | some o => true :: List.ofFn ((S).encDecOut κ pp o)

/-- The target is exactly the conjunction of its displayed algorithm obligations. 

**Proof sketch.** Destructure the target record into its fields; in the reverse direction, assemble
the record from the conjuncts. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.schemeTargets_iff
rows.statement:
theorem schemeTargets_iff :
    SchemeTargets G ℓ n d ↔
      (SamplesEfficiently
        (fun κ (g : GroupDescription (S).G κ) => g.val)
        (fun κ g (r : GeneratorDraw (S).G κ g) => List.ofFn (((S).G.group κ g.val).encG r.val))
        (fun κ _ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) => pp.encode) (publicParamsCore (S).G)) ∧
      (SamplesEfficiently
        (fun κ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) => pp.encode) (S).encSetupDraw
        (fun κ pp (o : (S).MPK κ pp × (S).MSK κ pp) =>
          pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMPK κ pp o.1)) (List.ofFn ((S).encMSK κ pp o.2)))
            (S).setupCore) ∧
      (SamplesEfficiently
        (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams (S).G κ,
            (S).MPK κ pp × (Fin ((C).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) × (Fin ((C).privLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
          pairEncode π.1.encode (pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMPK κ π.1 π.2.1))
            (pairEncode (List.ofFn π.2.2.1) (List.ofFn π.2.2.2))))
        (fun κ π => (S).encEncDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)
        (fun κ π (o : (S).CT κ π.1) => List.ofFn ((S).encCT κ π.1 o))
        (fun κ π => (S).encCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2.1 π.2.2.2)) ∧
      (SamplesEfficiently
        (fun κ (π : Σ pp : PublicParams (S).G κ, (S).MSK κ pp × (Fin ((C).fnLen.eval κ) → Bool)) =>
          pairEncode π.1.encode
            (pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMSK κ π.1 π.2.1)) (List.ofFn π.2.2)))
        (fun κ π => (S).encKeyDraw κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)
        (fun κ π (o : (S).SK κ π.1) => List.ofFn ((S).encSK κ π.1 o))
        (fun κ π => (S).keyCore κ π.1 π.2.1 π.2.2)) ∧
      (∃ a : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable a ∧
        ∀ κ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) (sk : (S).SK κ pp)
          (x : Fin ((C).pubLen.eval κ) → Bool) (ct : (S).CT κ pp),
          a (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode pp.encode
            (pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encSK κ pp sk))
              (pairEncode (List.ofFn x) (List.ofFn ((S).encCT κ pp ct)))))) =
            match (S).dec κ pp sk x ct with
            | none => [false]
            | some o => true :: List.ofFn ((S).encDecOut κ pp o))

rows.statement:
structure SimTargets : Prop where
  /-- The concrete committed simulator's setup draw and core satisfy the shared contract. -/
  sim_setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) => pp.encode) (Sim).encSetupDraw
    (fun κ pp (o : (S).MPK κ pp × (Sim).St κ pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMPK κ pp o.1)) ((Sim).encSt κ pp o.2)) (Sim).setupCore
  /-- The concrete committed simulator's enc draw and core satisfy the shared contract. -/
  sim_enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently (Sim).encInputWord
    (fun κ π => (Sim).encEncDraw κ π.pp π.state π.omega)
    (fun κ π (o : (S).CT κ π.pp × (Sim).St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encCT κ π.pp o.1)) ((Sim).encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => (Sim).encCore κ π.pp π.state π.omega)
  /-- The concrete committed simulator's key draw and core satisfy the shared contract. -/
  sim_key_eff : SamplesEfficiently (Sim).keyInputWord
    (fun κ π => (Sim).encKeyDraw κ π.pp π.state π.omega π.index)
    (fun κ π (o : (S).SK κ π.pp × (Sim).St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encSK κ π.pp o.1)) ((Sim).encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => (Sim).keyCore κ π.pp π.state π.omega π.index)
  /-- The concrete semi-adaptive simulator's setup draw and core satisfy the shared contract. -/
  sa_setup_eff : SamplesEfficiently
    (fun κ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) => pp.encode) (SASim).encSetupDraw
    (fun κ pp (o : (S).MPK κ pp × (SASim).St κ pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMPK κ pp o.1)) ((SASim).encSt κ pp o.2)) (SASim).setupCore
  /-- The concrete semi-adaptive simulator's enc draw and core satisfy the shared contract. -/
  sa_enc_eff : SamplesEfficiently (SASim).encInputWord
    (fun κ π => (SASim).encEncDraw κ π.pp π.state π.publicInput)
    (fun κ π (o : (S).CT κ π.pp × (SASim).St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encCT κ π.pp o.1)) ((SASim).encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => (SASim).encCore κ π.pp π.state π.publicInput)
  /-- The concrete semi-adaptive simulator's key draw and core satisfy the shared contract. -/
  sa_key_eff : SamplesEfficiently (SASim).keyInputWord
    (fun κ π => (SASim).encKeyDraw κ π.pp π.state π.publicInput π.function π.value)
    (fun κ π (o : (S).SK κ π.pp × (SASim).St κ π.pp) =>
      pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encSK κ π.pp o.1)) ((SASim).encSt κ π.pp o.2))
    (fun κ π => (SASim).keyCore κ π.pp π.state π.publicInput π.function π.value)

/-- The target is exactly the conjunction of its displayed algorithm obligations. 

**Proof sketch.** Destructure the target record into its fields; in the reverse direction, assemble
the record from the conjuncts. -/

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.AdvancedEncryption.FunctionalEncryption.Wee20.simTargets_iff
rows.statement:
theorem simTargets_iff :
    SimTargets G ℓ n d ↔
      (SamplesEfficiently
        (fun κ (pp : PublicParams (S).G κ) => pp.encode) (Sim).encSetupDraw
        (fun κ pp (o : (S).MPK κ pp × (Sim).St κ pp) =>
          pairEncode (List.ofFn ((S).encMPK κ pp o.1)) ((Sim).encSt κ pp o.2)) (Sim).setupCore) ∧
      (SamplesEfficiently (Sim).encInputWord

    (N : Matrix κ υ (ZMod B.order)) :
    matMulGroup M (B.expMat g N) = B.expMat g (M * N)

rows.statement:
theorem expMatT_mulVec [Fintype κ] (gT : B.GT) (M : Matrix ι κ (ZMod B.order))
    (a : κ → ZMod B.order) :
    groupMulVec (B.expMatT gT M) a = B.expVecT gT (M *ᵥ a)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGroup.pair_expVec
rows.statement:
theorem pair_expVec [Fintype ι] (g h : B.G) (a b : ι → ZMod B.order) :
    B.pairVec (B.expVec g a) (B.expVec h b) = B.pair g h ^ (dotProduct a b).val

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGroup.pair_expMat
rows.statement:
theorem pair_expMat [Fintype κ] (g h : B.G) (M : Matrix ι κ (ZMod B.order))
    (N : Matrix κ υ (ZMod B.order)) :
    B.pairMat (B.expMat g M) (B.expMat h N) = B.expMatT (B.pair g h) (M * N)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGroup.pairTensor_expVec
rows.statement:
theorem pairTensor_expVec (g h : B.G) (a : ι → ZMod B.order) (b : κ → ZMod B.order) :
    B.pairTensor (B.expVec g a) (B.expVec h b) =
      B.expVecT (B.pair g h) (fun ij : ι × κ => a ij.1 * b ij.2)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGroup.expVec_tensor_left
rows.statement:
theorem expVec_tensor_left (g : B.G) (a : ι → ZMod B.order) (b : κ → ZMod B.order) :
    (fun ij : ι × κ => B.expVec g a ij.1 ^ (b ij.2).val) =
      B.expVec g (fun ij : ι × κ => a ij.1 * b ij.2)

rows.statement:
theorem expVec_tensor_right (g : B.G) (a : ι → ZMod B.order) (b : κ → ZMod B.order) :
    (fun ij : ι × κ => B.expVec g b ij.2 ^ (a ij.1).val) =
      B.expVec g (fun ij : ι × κ => a ij.1 * b ij.2)

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGroup.pairVec_expVec_left
rows.statement:
theorem pairVec_expVec_left [Fintype ι] (g : B.G) (v : ι → ZMod B.order)
    (u : ι → B.G) :
    B.pairVec (B.expVec g v) u = B.pair g (groupDot u v)

rows.statement:
theorem dlinStr_eq {wG wT : ℕ} (B : BilinearGroup wG wT) (d : List Bool)
    (g a b u v w : B.G) :
    dlinStr B d g a b u v w =
      pairEncode d (pairEncode (List.ofFn (B.encG g))
        (pairEncode (List.ofFn (B.encG a)) (pairEncode (List.ofFn (B.encG b))

rows.statement:
structure DLINChallenge (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- The shared group description and nonidentity generator. -/
  pp : PublicParams G κ
  /-- The first base power `g^a`. -/
  baseA : (G.group κ pp.description.val).G
  /-- The second base power `g^b`. -/
  baseB : (G.group κ pp.description.val).G
  /-- The first response coordinate. -/
  responseA : (G.group κ pp.description.val).G
  /-- The second response coordinate. -/
  responseB : (G.group κ pp.description.val).G
  /-- The last response coordinate. -/
  responseSum : (G.group κ pp.description.val).G

/-- Attach five group points to the shared public parameters. This is technical glue for
the sampling experiment of [JLS26, §1.1, p. 3]. -/

    G.dlinEnc κ c =
      dlinStr (G.group κ c.pp.description.val) c.pp.description.val c.pp.generator
        c.baseA c.baseB c.responseA c.responseB c.responseSum

    G.dlinEnc κ (G.dlinChallenge κ pp a b u v w) =

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGen.dlinSample_eq
rows.statement:
theorem dlinSample_eq (real : Bool) (κ : ℕ) :
    G.dlinSample real κ =
      (publicParamsGen G κ).bind fun pp =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin 2 → ZMod (G.group κ pp.description.val).order)).bind fun ab =>
      (ProbComp.sample (Fin 2 → ZMod (G.group κ pp.description.val).order)).bind fun rs =>
      (ProbComp.sample (ZMod (G.group κ pp.description.val).order)).bind fun t =>
        .pure (G.dlinChallenge κ pp (pp.generator ^ (ab 0).val) (pp.generator ^ (ab 1).val)
          (pp.generator ^ (ab 0 * rs 0).val) (pp.generator ^ (ab 1 * rs 1).val)
          (pp.generator ^ (if real then rs 0 + rs 1 else t).val))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.exists_fiberwise_add_right_equiv
rows.statement:
theorem exists_fiberwise_add_right_equiv {U E P : Type*} [AddGroup E] [AddGroup P]
    (projection : E →+ P) (shift : U → P → E)
    (hshift : ∀ (u : U) (p : P), projection (shift u p) = 0) :
    ∃ e : (U × E) ≃ (U × E),
      (∀ (u : U) (x : E), e (u, x) = (u, x + shift u (projection x))) ∧
      (∀ (u : U) (x : E), e.symm (u, x) = (u, x - shift u (projection x))) ∧
      (∀ (u : U) (x : E), projection (e (u, x)).2 = projection x)

structure MDDHChallenge (d ℓ : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- The common public description and source-group generator. -/
  pp : PublicParams G κ
  /-- The implicit base matrix with exactly two columns. -/
  matrix : Matrix (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (Fin 2) (G.group κ pp.description.val).G
  /-- The implicit response with `d(κ)` columns. -/
  response : Matrix (Fin (ℓ.eval κ)) (Fin (d.eval κ)) (G.group κ pp.description.val).G

/-- Serialize the public parameters followed by the base and response matrices
[Wee20, §2.1, p. 4, Assumption 1]. The encoding contains no group-generator coin strings. -/

    G.mddhEnc d ℓ κ c =
      pairEncode c.pp.encode
        (pairEncode ((G.group κ c.pp.description.val).groupMatrixEnc c.matrix)
          ((G.group κ c.pp.description.val).groupMatrixEnc c.response))

rows.statement:
theorem dlinDiagonal_random_gap_le {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K]
    (H : (Fin 2 → K) → (Fin 3 → K) → ℝ)
    (hH0 : ∀ ab u, 0 ≤ H ab u) (hH1 : ∀ ab u, H ab u ≤ 1) :
    |ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin 2 → K))
        (fun ab => ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin 3 → K)) (H ab)) -
      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin 2 → K))
        (fun ab => ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin 2 → K))
          (fun rs => ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample K)
            (fun t => H ab ![ab 0 * rs 0, ab 1 * rs 1, t])))| ≤
      2 / (Fintype.card K : ℝ) - 1 / (Fintype.card K : ℝ) ^ 2

      (((∏ i : Fin n,

structure PublicParams (G : BilinearGen) (κ : ℕ) where
  /-- A description output by the group generator. -/
  description : GroupDescription G κ
  /-- The source-group generator used throughout this setup. -/
  generator : (G.group κ description.val).G
  /-- In a prime-order group every nonidentity element is a generator. -/
  generator_ne_one : generator ≠ 1

namespace PublicParams

/-- The group carried by public parameters is the group described by their public word. -/

theorem dlinToMddh_eq (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ)

    (κ : ℕ) (c : G.DLINChallenge κ) (r : List Bool) :
    G.dlinToMddh p hp d ℓ D ω κ c r =
      D.runAtL κ (G.mddhPre p hp d ℓ κ (ω κ) c) (r.take (D.coinLen κ))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGen.mddhSlack_eq
rows.statement:
theorem mddhSlack_eq (p : ℕ → ℕ) (d : PolyExpr) (κ : ℕ) :
    mddhSlack p d κ = (d.eval κ : ℝ) * (4 / (p κ : ℝ))

rows.name: TCSlib.Cryptography.Pairing.BilinearGen.mddhAdv_le
rows.statement:
theorem mddhAdv_le (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ)
    (d ℓ : PolyExpr) (D : NUPPT) :
    ∃ ω : ∀ κ, MddhAdvice p d ℓ κ, ∀ B : NUPPT,
      B.RealizesOn G.dlinEnc D.coins (G.dlinToMddh p hp d ℓ D ω) →
      ∀ κ, G.mddhAdv d ℓ D κ ≤
        (d.eval κ : ℝ) * G.dlinAdv B κ + mddhSlack p d κ

rows.statement:
theorem mddhRealizable_iff (p : ℕ → ℕ) (hp : ∀ κ r, (G.inst κ r).order = p κ)
    (d ℓ : PolyExpr) :
    G.MDDHRealizable p hp d ℓ ↔
      ∀ (D : NUPPT) (ω : ∀ κ, MddhAdvice p d ℓ κ), ∃ B : NUPPT,
        B.RealizesOn G.dlinEnc D.coins (G.dlinToMddh p hp d ℓ D ω)
